page_title: HAV 1-2 LEN | Le Havre v Lens 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Herve Koffi (Lens) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+1' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Herve Koffi comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
84' Here is a change. Abdoulaye Toure is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
83' A substitution has been made. Loic Nego goes off and Josue Casimir (Le Havre) comes on.
80' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

77' 1 - 2 Przemyslaw Frankowski produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Deiver Machado (Lens) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:2.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan Gradit (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Adrien Thomasson.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:23.
72' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Andre Ayew will be replaced by Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre).
71' A goal, which was scored by M'Bala Nzola (Lens), was disallowed due to offside.
69' A sweet pass inside the box gives Angelo Fulgini (Lens) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Goduine Koyalipou trots off the pitch and is replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Lens).
65' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' Florian Sotoca (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
64' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.

63' Florian Sotoca (Lens) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
62' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
62' There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
60' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) jumps into a tackle and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
57' The manager makes a subsitution with Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) coming on for Anass Zaroury.
54' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Arthur Desmas anticipates well and smothers the ball.
53' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
53' Florian Sotoca (Lens) and Przemyslaw Frankowski perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
52' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
51' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
39' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' That's unlucky! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
36' Le Havre are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
34' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
33' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

28' 1 - 1 Florian Sotoca shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 1:1.
28' Clement Turpin blows his whistle. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
28' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
25' Good work from Lens as they win a corner. Anass Zaroury (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
22' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Herve Koffi intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Le Havre can continue in their attacking effort.
21' Le Havre fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Lens) leaps to collect the ball.
20' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Le Havre have a corner.
18' The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
18' Deiver Machado (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lens.
15' Andy Diouf (Lens) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
15' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Anass Zaroury (Lens), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Now Lens have a corner.
13' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is awarded a yellow card.

12' Andy Diouf (Lens) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a low shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the middle of the goal, but it lacks power and Arthur Desmas pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
8' 1 - 0 Andre Ayew (Le Havre) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

8' Kevin Danso (Lens) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
7' Rough tackle by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
3' Wonderful movement by Lens. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' Andy Diouf (Lens) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Clement Turpin.
